description: This file defines two Odoo models for reporting: 'report.workcenter.load' and 'report.mrp.inout'. It includes database view initialization methods for generating reports on workcenter load and stock value variation.

classes.name: report_workcenter_load
classes.description: Model for reporting workcenter load, including weekly hours and cycles.

classes.name: report_mrp_inout
classes.description: Model for reporting stock value variation per week.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes database views for the reports.
